name: background-swarm
title: Swarm
description: Bốn mươi đốm sáng lượn quanh một tâm theo quỹ đạo nhiễu, cả bầy trôi chậm như đàn đom đóm.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio pt-swarm, written here): 40 dots (r 2.5) orbit a centre that drifts +-50 px in x (6 s) and +-20 px in y (3 s); dot i angle a = t x (0.6-1.4 rad/s, seeded) + i, radius 20 + smooth noise x 50 px; x = cos(a) r, y = sin(1.3 a) x 0.6 r (a Lissajous wobble); 1 in 5 accent. Make periods divide the loop length. Params: count (40) · radius (20–70 px) · drift (±50 / ±20 px) · seed.
